title: Business Name Brainstorm & Research
body: Brainstorm names and research availability and trademark conflicts. Start at state level, then federal.

title: Business Structure Decision
body: LLC vs PLLC vs PC. Most go with PLLC / LLC, eventually to be taxed as S-Corp once income is over $100k or so.

title: Register Legal Business Name
body: File Articles of Organization/Incorporation with State.

title: File Trade Names / DBA ("Doing Business As" names) if necessary
body: Doing Business As for patient-facing brand name

title: Obtain EIN (Employer Identification Number)
body: Employer Identification Number from IRS (don't buy from third party)

title: Membership Pricing Strategy / Break-Even Analysis
body: Decide membership pricing structure. Hint: keep it simple.

title: Location Selection Research
body: Mobile vs. Fixed location. Tip: Street visibility isn't that important

title: Join DPC Alliance
body: A group of like-minded physicians with some great membership benefits.

title: State Medical License Verification
body: Ensure your medical license is active and unrestricted in your practicing state

title: DEA Registration
body: Self explanatory!

title: NPI Number Application / Update
body: Make sure your NPI number information is updated and active

title: State Prescriber ID
body: State-specific prescriber identifier (if applicable)

title: PDMP Registration
body: Prescription Drug Monitoring Program access

title: Medicare Opt-Out Filing
body: If you choose to opt-out of Medicare, this is essential.

title: Telemedicine Licenses
body: If you'd like to care for patients in other states, you likely need an active license from that state.

title: Obtain Business License
body: City or county business operating license

title: State DPC Law Compliance
body: Review state-specific DPC regulations (don't just rely on AI summaries!)

title: Banking Setup
body: Open business bank account

title: Business Credit Card
body: Separate business expenses build credit

title: Bookkeeping: In-house or hire?
body: We recommend hiring this out asap, unless you're familiar with bookkeeping.

title: Payroll System Setup
body: Consider having bookkeeper do this. Not necessary if you're not hiring employees!

title: Accounting software
body: If hiring bookkeeper, they'll have it. If not, use Xero or Quickbooks.

title: Startup Funding Secured
body: Highly recommend bootstrapping, but if securing funds, do not use credit card debt to fund

title: Malpractice Insurance
body: Recommend going through DPC Alliance to find malpractice insurance

title: General Liability Insurance
body: General coverage (slip & fall, plus other general coverages)

title: Cyber Liability Insurance
body: Data breach coverage (ask what comes with malpractice, pair either w/ malpractice or general liability)

title: Domain Name
body: This is "yourdomainname.com" and will be used for email, website, etc. — expect a small yearly renewal.

title: EMR System Selection
body: Major systems for DPC are Elation, Hint, AtlasMD, AkuteHealth, and others

title: Membership Billing Software
body: For automated recurring billing, accepting payments in person, and more. Major systems are AtlasMD, Hint, Quickbooks, and others

title: Telehealth Platform
body: Will often pair with your EMR: check for HIPAA compliance if not

title: Practice Email System
body: Professional and scalable email system. Major players are Microsoft, Google, Zoho, and many others.

title: Phone System
body: Important to have a business line separate from cell phone. Many good options here.

title: Secure Messaging System
body: Patient Communication: HIPAA compliant if possible, but have necessary forms for email / insecure messaging.

title: Electronic Fax Service
body: HIPAA-compliant faxing - often will come with EMR

title: IT - hire or manage in-house?
body: Decide if you are going to manage IT needs (computers, phone, storage, etc.) in-house or with a professional. Highly recommend eventually using a professional for security reasons.

title: Data Backup System
body: If you store anything of importance on local computers, ensure you have automated backups.

title: IT Security Measures
body: Understand how wifi, computer access, and much more is setup to ensure security.

title: Password Manager
body: HIGHLY recommend using a password manager such as Dashlane, 1Password, or others.

title: Practice Website Development
body: Made mostly for potential members - should mostly act as a 'salesman' that informs people about membership.

title: Website Maintenance
body: If you hire to have your site built, then ask about maintenance plans. If building yourself, update monthly or quarterly at least. Hosting belongs here too: on its own it should cost very little, and it usually costs more only when it is bundled with a maintenance plan.

title: SEO Setup
body: Ensure your website includes all necessary SEO information for local search.

title: Google Business Profile
body: Start & claim your Google Business Profile after you know your location, have email & phone setup.

title: Logo / Brand Development
body: The cost for this is a huge range, especially with AI and other options on the internet. Logo, font, colors can always change. Invest only as much as you're comfortable - this is less important than most people think.

title: Marketing Materials Design
body: Order of importance: business card, flyers, banners, signage

title: Social Media Presence
body: Only start and have profiles that you'll remain at least semi-active on.

title: Content Marketing Plan
body: Write for clarity - not for being cute or "unique." It's better to make things crystal clear for your potential patients.

title: Community Outreach Plan
body: Consider ribbon cutting, chamber of commerce events, and more

title: Press Release Preparation
body: Prepare a piece for local media outlets - email out 2-6 weeks prior to opening

title: Email Marketing Setup
body: Consider using a mass newsletter solution like Kit, MailChimp or similar rather than internal mailing

title: Patient Education Materials
body: DPC model explanation wellness resources

title: List of Services
body: Create a list of services that you do and do not provide and whether they are included in membership or not (tip: include as much as possible in membership to keep things simple).

title: Formulary Development
body: Preferred medication list

title: Medical Record Standards
body: Documentation requirements templates

title: Prescription Policies
body: Refill protocols controlled substances

title: After-Hours Protocol
body: On-call coverage emergency response

title: Emergency Procedures
body: Code response emergency equipment

title: Specialist Network Development
body: Referral relationships for common needs

title: Pharmacy Relationships
body: Preferred pharmacy discount programs

title: Lab Services Provider
body: In-office vs reference lab

title: Imaging Center Network
body: X-ray MRI CT ultrasound contacts

title: DME Supplier Relationships
body: Durable medical equipment sources

title: Mental Health Contacts
body: Therapist psychiatrist network

title: Home Health Coordination
body: Post-hospital care coordination

title: Patient Membership Agreement
body: Contract terms cancellation policy

title: Member Handbook Creation
body: Services hours communication policies

title: Patient Forms Development
body: Intake medical history consent forms

title: New Patient Onboarding Flow
body: Enrollment welcome process orientation

title: Patient Communication Preferences
body: Text email portal visit preferences

title: Appointment Policies
body: Scheduling same-day urgent visit policies

title: Cancellation Policy
body: No-show late cancellation procedures

title: Patient Feedback System
body: Satisfaction surveys improvement process

title: Office Location Lease
body: Negotiate lease terms buildout allowance

title: Office Design & Layout
body: Exam rooms waiting area workflow

title: Office Buildout
body: Construction improvements finishes

title: Medical Equipment Purchase
body: Exam tables BP cuffs EKG etc

title: Office Furniture
body: Desks chairs waiting room

title: Office Supplies
body: The basics: pens, paper clips, printers, etc.

title: Medical Supplies & Inventory
body: Clinical supplies office supplies

title: Point-of-Care Testing Setup
body: Urinalysis A1C strep flu etc (tip: make sure CLIA waivers include all tests you want: see Phase 10)

title: Signage Installation
body: Exterior building interior directional

title: Utilities & Services Setup
body: Electric water internet janitorial

title: Staff Hiring Plan
body: Job descriptions hiring timeline

title: Employee Handbook
body: Policies benefits expectations

title: HR Compliance Setup
body: I-9 W-4 background checks

title: Staff Training
body: EMR phone systems clinical workflows

title: Benefits Administration
body: Health insurance retirement if offered

title: Policies & Procedures Manual
body: TIP: No need to have this manual prepared - just have a binder or file ready to go. When you hire your first hire, part of their job is to keep this policies and procedures manual up-to-date, so then you have everything ready to go for new hires!

title: Mock Patient Visits
body: Practice workflows troubleshoot issues

title: Soft Launch Planning
body: Friends family limited enrollment

title: Final Inspections
body: Fire safety health department

title: Risk Management Review
body: Final compliance check

title: HIPAA Compliance Program / Training
body: Understand how to remain HIPAA compliant, and if there's a breach, understand what needs to be done.

title: Business Associate Agreements
body: Make sure you have signed BAA's on file (vendors should have them available) for all who are handling PHI

title: CLIA Waiver Application / Certificate
body: Certificate for point-of-care testing if applicable (usually from the state)

title: Controlled Substance Protocols
body: Policies for prescribing, monitoring, storage of scheduled prescriptions

title: Official Launch
body: Open for business grand opening

title: Launch Event
body: Community celebration open house

title: Press Outreach
body: Media announcements interviews
